comment: Checkout was quick and the discount code worked on my first try.
Payment failed twice but my bank showed two temporary holds.
Parcel arrived a day early and the courier was polite.
Delivery arrived four days late without any tracking update.
Search found similar items but filters reset whenever I returned to results.
The support agent fixed my return request within ten minutes.
I waited two days for a response about a damaged item.
App is easy to navigate and saved my preferred address.
App crashed three times when I opened the cart on Android.
Product was fine, but the outer box was much bigger than needed.
The headphones sound excellent and match the listing.
Received the wrong colour, despite choosing black at checkout.
Pickup for my return was arranged the next morning.
Refund still has not arrived twelve days after my return was accepted.
Tracking notifications were accurate throughout delivery.
The coupon showed as valid but disappeared on the payment page.
Categories were clear, although sorting by price was inconsistent.
Chat support explained warranty coverage clearly.
The delivery window changed twice and no explanation was provided.
The new app layout made reordering much easier.
Return pickup was missed and I had to contact support again.
The laptop stand feels sturdy and the dimensions were accurate.
Packaging protected the item, but too much plastic was used.
The helpdesk sent an automated reply instead of answering my billing question.
